notes: Four words naming a well-known suburban roleplay town is still a complete brief: it is Roleplay & Avatar Sim, and the author confirmed players claim prebuilt houses rather than building on plots, so the housing model is settlement-claimable and the Life preset applies whole. Drivable cars were confirmed outright with roads about 20 studs wide, which sits inside the option's 15-to-30-stud band, so path-road-vehicle is asked for rather than assumed here. Houses players move into and the town's shops are entered from the street, and the claimable model carries interiors as well, so the route is P3. Decided without a user: the pastel cosy styling is theme rather than layout, and district-zoned keeps the shopfronts off the residential streets in the way the reference town does.
